t: Anthropic Soars in Market Debut Amid Tanking Stocks
s: Anthropic experienced a massive surge during its market debut while overall stocks fell, marking a rare feat achieved by only one other IPO since 1990. The event prompted an examination of S&P 500 performance following that historical IPO, alongside notable developments including a CoreWeave co-founder's investment in bonds and increased consumer preparations involving food and cash in response to recent tech outages.
